full_judgment:
5. The trial Court upon hearing the par-ties and on perusal of the materials on record decreed the suit on contest against the contesting defendant Nos.1 and 2 and ex parte against the rest by judgment and decree dated 22.10.2007 and thereby declared enlistment of the names of the defendent Nos.6 to 11 as teachers of the said school is totally illegal and accordingly directed defendant Nos.1 to 5 and 12 to 15 by mandatory injunction to include the names of the plaintiffs in place of defendant Nos.6 to 11 in the BANBASE and MPO and to take necessary steps to pay the entire dues of the plaintiffs. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree, contesting defendant Nos.1 and 2, i.e. the President of the Managing Committee and the Headmaster of the school preferred Title Appeal No.05 of 2008 in the Court of learned District Judge, Pirojpur, who by his judgment and order dated 19.03.2013 dismissed the appeal and affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court. Against the same, defendant Nos.1 and 2 filed Civil Revision No. 2537 of 2015 before the High Court Division under section 115 (1) 01 the Code of Civil Procedure, During pendency of the civil revision before the High Court Division, an application was filed by the present appellants for transposing of opposite party No. 8-13 in Civil Revision No. 2537 of 2013 as petitioner Nos. 3-8 respectively. The said application was allowed by order dated 08.12.2016 transposing the appellants as petitioner No.3-8. 

 7. Upon hearing the Rule, the High Court Division discharged the same by the impugned judgment order dated 08.06.2017 affirming the judgment and decree passed by the Courts below. 

 12. In the instant case, it is admitted position that the trial Court decreed the suit, which was affirmed by the Court of Appeal below and the High Court Division in revision, also did not interfere with the judgment and decree of the Courts below. The learned Advocate for the appellants has tried to impress us that the plaintiffs were not appointed by the school authority and they left the school voluntarily and, thereafter, the defendant appellants have been appointed in their place and got MPO. 

 Be that as it may; I find no misreading or non-reading of evidence or non-consideration of material facts resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice by which the impugned judgment and decree can be interfered with."
